elements.element: Transition obligations apply on expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Inserted clause opens: "Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement, or of Teleglobe USA Inc.'s participation in this Agreement, the other Parties shall ...", capturing both expiry and termination (including partial-participation termination under 18.1).

elements.element: Vendor provides transition assistance for up to six months.
elements.evidence: Operative text says "transition assistance for a period of not less than ninety (90) days"; there is no six-month duration. To reach preferred, change to "for up to six (6) months".

elements.element: Transition assistance is charged at then-current rates.
elements.evidence: The inserted clause is silent on pricing; no "then-current rates" language appears anywhere in the rendered paragraph.

elements.element: Vendor returns Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: "(b) within thirty (30) days of such expiry or termination, export and deliver to Teleglobe USA Inc. all data and records belonging to, supplied by or processed for Teleglobe USA Inc. under this Agreement" — the 30-day clock runs from expiry/termination, not from a request.

elements.element: Customer Data is returned in a standard machine-readable format.
elements.evidence: Clause (b) requires export and delivery but specifies no format; add "in a commonly used, machine-readable format".

elements.element: Vendor certifies deletion of Customer Data after its return.
elements.evidence: No deletion or written-certification limb exists in the inserted text; a limb (c) requiring deletion and written certification would be needed.

elements.element: Transition obligations apply on expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Trigger is expressly "Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement, or of Teleglobe USA Inc.'s participation in this Agreement".

elements.element: Vendor provides at least 90 days of transition assistance.
elements.evidence: "(a) at Teleglobe USA Inc.'s request, provide transition assistance for a period of not less than ninety (90) days" — floor of 90 days, satisfying "at least 90 days".

elements.element: Vendor exports Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: "(b) within thirty (30) days of such expiry or termination, export and deliver ... all data and records belonging to, supplied by or processed for Teleglobe USA Inc." — export obligation, 30-day deadline anchored to expiry/termination, and scope covers every category of data belonging to, supplied by or processed for Customer.

reasons: Fallback checklist is complete: the single inserted sentence supplies the expiry/termination trigger, a 90-day assistance floor, and a 30-day data export measured from expiry or termination, with data scope broad enough to capture all Customer data and records.

Preferred level fails on four elements: six-month duration, then-current rates, machine-readable format, and post-return deletion certification. If the preferred position is pursued, the drafter must (i) change "not less than ninety (90) days" to "up to six (6) months", (ii) add "at the other Parties' then-current rates", (iii) add "in a commonly used, machine-readable format" to limb (b), and (iv) add a limb (c) requiring deletion of the data and written certification of deletion.

Minimality holds: the finding is 'missing' and a concise insertion of new words is permitted; the redline adds no survival tail, expense allocation, remedy, procedure, or other requirement outside the fallback checklist, and no existing favourable language (18.1, 18.4, 18.5, 18.7, 23.3) was deleted or paraphrased.

Intent is preserved: the realization-of-assets, assumption-of-interests, residual third-party liability and Terminal Station continuity mechanics survive unchanged and do not contradict the new exit obligation, which addresses only assistance and data/records return; no undefined term or dangling cross-reference is created.

Drafting nit (not a failure): the rationale and comment refer to "Subparagraph 18.8" but the rendered insertion carries no number — add the "18.8" designation for consistency with the paragraph's numbering convention.
